completion:
Get the P&L statement for the past 12 months of history. 
3. Confirm each line item of the income statement is well documented.
4. If there are line items that are not clear, ask the client to provide supporting documentation.
5. Confirm the timing of the revenue recognition (whether it be time and materials recognition or a completed-contract recognition).
6. Ensure the method of revenue recognition is consistent for the company's income statement period.
7. Get the Balance Sheet as of the same period of the income statement.
